subject.title: fix(ui): authenticate managed workspace image previews

question: Do the Control UI and Gateway owners confirm that the workspace may use the live device token or configured shared secret to fetch approved same-origin managed outgoing-media URLs through the existing HTTP authorization boundary?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically bounded and proven, but whether this additional UI caller is an intended use of the existing credential-routing contract is a security-boundary ownership decision rather than a contributor-side code choice.

options.title: Confirm the existing media contract
options.body: Confirm that approved same-origin workspace previews may reuse the existing authenticated managed-media route, then proceed with normal merge gating.

options.title: Require a narrower UI-to-Gateway seam
options.body: Pause this PR and specify a dedicated credential or RPC boundary if the workspace must not send the existing token to that route.

recommendation.title: Confirm the existing media contract
recommendation.body: Confirm that approved same-origin workspace previews may reuse the existing authenticated managed-media route, then proceed with normal merge gating.

likelyOwner.reason: Visible feature history ties this person most directly to the Gateway managed-media route whose caller contract needs confirmation.
